CANONICAL SCHEMA

One contract for every channel.

Map source columns to six required fields. Invalid records are quarantined; the first valid record for each platform + ID is kept.

FieldRuleRecognized aliases

Transformation rules

Text is trimmed and repeated whitespace collapsed. Platforms become lowercase. Whole-number metrics accept correctly grouped thousands separators. Dates must be real calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. Engagement rate is engagements ÷ views × 100; zero views produces null, not a fabricated percentage.

CSV exports escape spreadsheet formula prefixes. JSON exports retain exact normalized text. Engagements may exceed views because these fields can aggregate different types of actions.
